QuestInfo.name: Dances with Balrog's Reply
QuestInfo.0: #p511# in #m10004000# seems to want to send a reply to #p800018# in the #m80002000#.
QuestInfo.1: #p511# in #m10004000# asked me to deliver a reply to #p800018# in the #m80002000#.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #p511#'s letter to #p800018# in the #m80002000#.

0.0: A Free Market... Yes, that sounds acceptable. All things must follow their natural course. There is no reason for us here in #m10004000# to oppose a place where the growing number of adventurers can gather.
0.1: I shall discuss this matter with the townspeople. Now, take this letter and deliver it to that young man, #p800018#.

1.0: Oh, #p511# sent a reply! I really hope he looks at this project positively... Let's see what it says.
1.1: Ah, I see! #p511# mentioned that as long as it's for the sake of the adventurers, he'll provide all the necessary help to keep this Free Market running smoothly. What a relief.
1.2: Thanks to you, it looks like we'll be getting support from multiple towns. If that's the case, this Free Market will surely become a place where even more adventurers gather. Thank you so much for all your help. I'll keep working hard to develop this place for everyone, so keep an eye out for us!

item.0: You say #p511# wrote a reply? But wait, where is the letter?

lost.0: It seems you have lost my letter. How on earth did you manage to lose it? I will write it again for you, so be careful this time.
